name: prebuilt/name-and-domain-to-email-waterfall
displayName: Work Email from Name and Domain
description: Find a mailbox-verified work email at the supplied company domain, cascading across providers until one returns a matching hit.

company_name.description: Optional company name for provider context.

linkedin_url.description: Optional LinkedIn profile URL for provider context.

steps.paramsSource:

subgraph cascade["Try each source until one returns an email"]

  datagma --> findymail(["Findymail"])
  findymail --> icypeas(["Icypeas"])
  icypeas --> prospeo(["Prospeo · verified addresses only"])
  prospeo --> pdl_email(["PDL · work email required"])
  pdl_email --> answer(["Return the email and how it was found"])
end
